South African Jurist Navi Pillay Awarded Nobel Peace Prize

Navi Pillay, a South African jurist of Indian origin, has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her significant contributions to international law and human rights. Her ancestors migrated from India to Durban. She is described as following in the footsteps of Mahatma Gandhi.
